method: Kul takes the AI's exact trades (same entry and exit times, same stop and target levels) and picks the side with a seeded coin flip per trade (Episode 2 paw-pick). When he disagrees, the price move flips and he still pays the same costs: commission plus 1.5 ticks slippage per fill. His worst open loss = the AI's best open profit + slippage. 1,000 Kuls per version; in-sample trades 2021-09 to 2024-08.
seeds: Kul k on version i: 1e6*(i+1)+k (i=0 v006, i=1 v007); evaluation MC seed 777000+k, 1,000 runs each, eval-only rules
